name: Health Goth
places: Seattle/online (the look was named by a trio who ran a Tumblr and Facebook page)
garments: Nike and Reebok logos reframed as goth iconography
reacts_against: both the color-saturated 2010s athleisure boom and the ornamental excess of traditional goth — it kept goth's black-on-black mood but swapped velvet for performance fabric.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Monochrome sportswear, mesh fabrics, technical sneakers, performance gear, clean lines, futuristic graphics, transhumanist elements
wiki_facts.key_values: Futurism, minimalism, performance, technology, clean aesthetics, transhumanism

findings: mostly muted — about 97% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
